units.zh: 列傳第四十九 袁粲
units.en: Biography Number Forty-Nine: Yuan Can
units.literal: Biography 49: Yuan Can

units.zh: 袁粲，字景倩，陳郡陽夏人，太尉淑兄子也。
units.en: Yuan Can, styled Jingqian, was a native of Yangxia in Chen Commandery and a nephew of Grand Marshal Shu.
units.literal: Yuan Can, style name Jingqian, was a man of Yangxia in Chen Commandery, a nephew of Grand Marshal Shu.

units.zh: 父濯，揚州秀才，蚤卒。
units.en: His father Zhuo was a Yang Province outstanding youth and died young.
units.literal: His father Zhuo was a Yang Province outstanding youth and died young.

units.zh: 祖母哀其幼孤，名之曰愍孫。
units.en: His grandmother pitied him as a young orphan and named him Min Sun.
units.literal: His grandmother pitied him as a young orphan and named him Min Sun.

units.zh: 伯叔並當世榮顯，而愍孫饑寒不足。
units.en: His uncles were all illustrious in the age, yet Min Sun lacked food and clothing.
units.literal: His uncles were all illustrious in the age, yet Min Sun lacked food and clothing.

units.zh: 母琅邪王氏，太尉長史誕之女也，躬事績紡，以供朝夕。
units.en: His mother was of the Wang clan of Langye, daughter of the Grand Marshal's chief clerk Dan; she personally spun and wove to supply their daily needs.
units.literal: His mother was the Wang clan of Langye, daughter of the Grand Marshal's chief clerk Dan; she personally did spinning and weaving to supply morning and evening.

units.zh: 愍孫少好學，有清才，有欲與從兄顗婚者，伯父洵即顗父，曰：「顗不堪，政可與愍孫婚耳。」
units.en: Min Sun from youth loved learning and had pure talent; someone wished to marry him to his cousin Yi; his uncle Xun, who was also Yi's father, said: "Yi is not fit; he should marry Min Sun instead."
units.literal: Min Sun from youth loved learning and had pure talent; someone wished to marry him to his cousin Yi; his uncle Xun, who was also Yi's father, said: "Yi is not fit; he should marry Min Sun instead."

units.zh: 時愍孫在坐，流涕起出。
units.en: Min Sun was present; weeping, he rose and left the room.
units.literal: At the time Min Sun was present; weeping, he rose and went out.

units.zh: 蚤以操立志行見知。
units.en: Early on he was known for integrity in aspiration and conduct.
units.literal: Early he was known for integrity in establishing aspiration and conduct.

units.zh: 初為揚州從事，世祖安北、鎮軍、北中郎行參軍，侍中郎主簿。
units.en: He began as a Yang Province attendant, then served as acting Army Staff Officer under the future Emperor Xiaowu in his Pacifying the North, Stabilizing the Army, and Northern Interior posts, and as chief clerk to the Secretariat Attendant.
units.literal: Initially he was a Yang Province attendant; acting Army Staff Officer for the Shizuo's Pacifying the North, Stabilizing the Army, and Northern Interior posts; Secretariat Attendant chief clerk.

units.zh: 世祖伐逆，轉記室參軍。
units.en: When the future emperor campaigned against rebels, he was transferred to Recording Army Staff Officer.
units.literal: When the Shizu campaigned against rebels, he was transferred to Recording Army Staff Officer.

units.zh: 及即位，除尚書吏部郎，太子右衛率，侍中。
units.en: When he took the throne, Min Sun was made Secretariat Director of the Ministry of Personnel, Right Guard of the Heir, and Palace Attendant.
units.literal: When he took the throne, Min Sun was made Secretariat Director of the Ministry of Personnel, Right Guard of the Heir, and Palace Attendant.

units.zh: 孝建元年，世祖率群臣並於中興寺八關齋，中食竟，愍孫別與黃門郎張淹更進魚肉食。
units.en: In the first year of Xiaojian, the emperor led the hundred officials in the eight precepts fast at Zhongxing Temple; when the midday meal was finished, Min Sun separately with Cavalier Attendant Zhang Yan further took fish and meat.
units.literal: In the first year of Xiaojian, the Shizu led the hundred officials together in the eight precepts fast at Zhongxing Temple; when the midday meal was finished, Min Sun separately with Cavalier Attendant Zhang Yan further took fish and meat food.

units.zh: 尚書令何尚之奉法素謹，密以白世祖，世祖使御史中丞王謙之糾奏，並免官。
units.en: Secretariat Director He Shangzhi, who always observed the law strictly, secretly reported it to the emperor; the emperor had Imperial Censor Wang Qianzhi impeach them, and both were dismissed from office.
units.literal: Secretariat Director He Shangzhi in observing the law was always strict; secretly he reported it to the Shizu; the Shizu had Imperial Censor Wang Qianzhi impeach them, and both were dismissed from office.

units.zh: 二年，起為廷尉，太子中庶子，領右軍將軍。
units.en: In the second year, he was recalled as Minister of Justice, Household Mentor of the Heir, and concurrently General of the Right Army.
units.literal: In the second year, he was recalled as Minister of Justice, Household Mentor of the Heir, and concurrently General of the Right Army.

units.zh: 出為輔國將軍、西陽王子尚北中郎長史、廣陵太守，行兗州事。
units.en: He went out as General Who Assists the State, Army Staff Officer to the Prince of Xiyang Zishang as Northern Interior Lord, and Governor of Guangling, acting for Yan Province affairs.
units.literal: He went out as General Who Assists the State, Army Staff Officer to the Prince of Xiyang Zishang as Northern Interior Lord, and Governor of Guangling, acting for Yan Province affairs.

units.zh: 仍為永嘉王子仁冠軍長史，將軍、太守如故。
units.en: He was then Army Staff Officer to the Prince of Yongjia Ziren as Champion, with his general and governorship posts unchanged.
units.literal: He was then Army Staff Officer to the Prince of Yongjia Ziren as Champion, with his general and governorship posts unchanged.

units.zh: 大明元年，復為侍中，領射聲校尉，封興平縣子，食邑五百戶，事在顏師伯傳。
units.en: In the first year of Daming, he was again made Palace Attendant and concurrently Commandant of the Archers' Corps, enfeoffed as Viscount of Xingping with a fief of five hundred households; the affair is treated in Yan Shibo's biography.
units.literal: In the first year of Daming, he was again made Palace Attendant and concurrently Commandant of the Archers' Corps, enfeoffed as Viscount of Xingping with a fief of five hundred households; the affair is treated in Yan Shibo's biography.

units.zh: 三年，坐納山陰民丁彖文貨，舉為會稽郡孝廉，免官。
units.en: In the third year, he was punished for accepting goods from Ding Tuan, a commoner of Shanyin, and recommending him as a filial and incorrupt candidate for Kuaiji commandery; he was dismissed from office.
units.literal: In the third year, he was punished for accepting goods from Ding Tuan, a commoner of Shanyin, and recommending him as a filial and incorrupt candidate for Kuaiji commandery; he was dismissed from office.

units.zh: 尋為西陽王子尚撫軍長史，又為中庶子，領左軍將軍。
units.en: Soon he was Army Staff Officer to the Prince of Xiyang Zishang as Stabilizing Army, then Household Mentor, and concurrently General of the Left Army.
units.literal: Soon he was Army Staff Officer to the Prince of Xiyang Zishang as Stabilizing Army, then Household Mentor, and concurrently General of the Left Army.

units.zh: 四年，出補豫章太守，加秩中二千石。
units.en: In the fourth year, he went out to fill the post of Governor of Yuzhang, with rank raised to equivalent to two thousand shi.
units.literal: In the fourth year, he went out to fill the post of Governor of Yuzhang, with rank raised to equivalent to two thousand shi.

units.zh: 五年，復還為侍中，領長水校尉，遷左衞將軍，加給事中。
units.en: In the fifth year, he returned as Palace Attendant, concurrently Commandant of the Chang River Corps, was transferred to General of the Left Guard, and additionally made Palace Provisioner.
units.literal: In the fifth year, he returned as Palace Attendant, concurrently Commandant of the Chang River Corps, was transferred to General of the Left Guard, and additionally made Palace Provisioner.

units.zh: 七年，轉吏部尚書，左衞如故。
units.en: In the seventh year, he was transferred to Director of the Ministry of Personnel, with his Left Guard post unchanged.
units.literal: In the seventh year, he was transferred to Director of the Ministry of Personnel, with his Left Guard post unchanged.

units.zh: 其年，皇太子冠，上臨宴東宮，愍孫勸顏師伯酒，師伯不飲，愍孫因相裁辱，師伯見寵於上，上常嫌愍孫以寒素凌之，因此發怒，出為海陵太守。
units.en: That year, when the Heir Apparent received the capping ceremony, the emperor attended a feast at the Eastern Palace; Min Sun urged Yan Shibo to drink wine, but Shibo refused; Min Sun therefore abused and humiliated him; Shibo was favored by the emperor, who had often resented Min Sun for lording over him on account of his humble origins; for this the emperor became angry and sent Min Sun out as Governor of Hailing.
units.literal: That year, when the Heir Apparent received the capping ceremony, the emperor attended a feast at the Eastern Palace; Min Sun urged Yan Shibo to drink wine, but Shibo refused; Min Sun therefore abused and humiliated him; Shibo was favored by the emperor, who had often resented Min Sun for lording over him on account of his humble origins; for this the emperor became angry and sent Min Sun out as Governor of Hailing.

units.zh: 前廢帝即位，除御史中丞，不拜。
units.en: When the Former Deposed Emperor took the throne, he was appointed Imperial Censor but did not accept.
units.literal: When the Former Deposed Emperor took the throne, he was appointed Imperial Censor but did not accept.

units.zh: 復為吏部尚書。
units.en: He was again made Director of the Ministry of Personnel.
units.literal: He was again made Director of the Ministry of Personnel.

units.zh: 永光元年，徙右衞將軍，加給事中。
units.en: In the first year of Yongguang, he was moved to General of the Right Guard and additionally made Palace Provisioner.
units.literal: In the first year of Yongguang, he was moved to General of the Right Guard and additionally made Palace Provisioner.

units.zh: 景和元年，復入為侍中，領驍騎將軍。
units.en: In the first year of Jinghe, he again entered court as Palace Attendant and concurrently General of the Valiant Cavalry.
units.literal: In the first year of Jinghe, he again entered court as Palace Attendant and concurrently General of the Valiant Cavalry.

units.zh: 太宗泰始元年，轉司徒左長史，冠軍將軍，南東海太守。
units.en: In the first year of Taishi under Emperor Ming, he was transferred to Left Chief Clerk to the Minister of Education (Situ), Champion General, and Governor of Southern Donghai.
units.literal: In the first year of Taishi under Emperor Ming, he was transferred to Left Army Staff Officer of the Ministry of Rites, General Who Conquers, and Governor of Southern Donghai.

units.zh: 愍孫清整有風操，自遇甚厚，常著《妙德先生傳》以續嵇康《高士傳》以自況，曰：
units.en: Min Sun was pure, orderly, and possessed integrity; he thought highly of himself and often wrote "Biography of Mr. Wonderful Virtue" to continue Ji Kang's "Biographies of Lofty Men" as self-portrait, saying:
units.literal: Min Sun was pure, orderly, and had wind and integrity; he thought highly of himself and often wrote "Biography of Mr. Wonderful Virtue" to continue Ji Kang's "Biographies of Lofty Men" as self-comparison, saying:

units.zh: 氣志淵虛，姿神清映，性孝履順，棲沖業簡，有舜之遺風。
units.en: His spirit and aspiration were deep and serene, his bearing and spirit clear and luminous; his nature was filial and his conduct compliant; he dwelt in simplicity and his pursuits were plain—he had the remnant virtue of Shun.
units.literal: His vital breath and aspiration were deep and empty, his bearing and spirit clear and reflected; his nature was filial and his conduct compliant; he dwelt in emptiness and his enterprise was simple—he had the remnant wind of Shun.

units.zh: 先生幼夙多疾，性疏懶，無所營尚，然九流百氏之言，雕龍談天之藝，皆泛識其大歸，而不以成名。
units.en: The gentleman from youth had many illnesses; his nature was loose and lazy and he pursued nothing in particular; yet the words of the nine streams and hundred schools, and the arts of rhetoric and cosmology, he broadly knew in outline, yet did not make a name thereby.
units.literal: The gentleman from youth and early life had many illnesses; his nature was loose and lazy and he had nothing he pursued or esteemed; yet the words of the nine streams and hundred schools, and the arts of carved dragons and heaven-discussing, he all broadly knew their great direction, yet did not make a name thereby.

units.zh: :家貧嘗仕，非其好也，混其聲迹，晦其心用，故深交或迕，俗察罔識。
units.en: His family was poor and he once served in office—it was not to his liking; he blended his voice and tracks and hid his heart's purpose; therefore close friends sometimes parted ways, and ordinary observers did not know him.
units.literal: His family was poor and he once served in office—it was not to his liking; he blended his voice and tracks and hid his heart's purpose; therefore close friends sometimes parted ways, and ordinary observers did not know him.

units.zh: 所處席門常掩，三徑裁通，雖揚子寂漠，嚴叟沈冥，不是過也。
units.en: Where he dwelt, the reed door was always shut and the three paths barely connected; though Yang Xiong was silent and remote and Yan Zun was deep and hidden, he surpassed them both.
units.literal: Where he dwelt, the reed door was always shut and the three paths barely connected; though Yangzi was silent and remote and old Yan was deep and hidden, it was not excessive.

units.zh: 修道遂志，終無得而稱焉。
units.en: Cultivating the Way and fulfilling his aspiration, in the end he had no one who could praise him.
units.literal: Cultivating the Way and fulfilling his aspiration, in the end he had no one who could praise him.

units.zh: 又嘗謂周旋人曰：「昔有一國，國中一水，號曰狂泉。
units.en: He also once said to his companions: "Formerly there was a state; in the state was a water called the Mad Spring.
units.literal: He also once said to his companions: "Formerly there was a state; in the state was a water called the Mad Spring.

units.zh: 國人飲此水，無不狂，唯國君穿井而汲，獨得無恙。
units.en: The people of the state drank this water and all went mad; only the lord of the state dug a well and drew water, alone remaining unharmed.
units.literal: The people of the state drank this water and all went mad; only the lord of the state dug a well and drew water, alone remaining unharmed.

units.zh: 國人既並狂，反謂國主之不狂為狂。
units.en: The people of the state, having all gone mad, in turn said the lord of the state's sanity was madness.
units.literal: The people of the state, having all gone mad, in turn said the lord of the state's not being mad was madness.

units.zh: 於是聚謀，共執國主，療其狂疾。
units.en: Thereupon they gathered in counsel, together seized the lord of the state, and treated his supposed madness.
units.literal: Thereupon they gathered in counsel, together seized the lord of the state, and treated his mad illness.

units.zh: 火艾針藥，莫不畢具。
units.en: Fire cautery, needles, and medicines—nothing was lacking.
units.literal: Fire cautery, needles, and medicines—nothing was not fully provided.

units.zh: 國主不任其苦，於是到泉所酌水飲之，飲畢便狂。
units.en: The lord of the state could not bear the suffering; thereupon he went to the spring, drew water, and drank it; when he finished drinking he at once went mad.
units.literal: The lord of the state could not bear the suffering; thereupon he went to the spring's place, drew water, and drank it; when he finished drinking he at once went mad.

units.zh: 君臣大小，其狂若一，眾乃歡然。
units.en: Lord and ministers, great and small, their madness was alike, and the multitude thereupon rejoiced.
units.literal: Lord and ministers, great and small, their madness was as one, and the multitude thereupon rejoiced.

units.zh: 我既不狂，難以獨立，比亦欲試飲此水。」
units.en: I am not mad and it is hard to stand alone; I too wish to try drinking this water."
units.literal: I am not mad and it is hard to stand alone; I too wish to try drinking this water."

units.zh: 愍孫幼慕荀奉倩之為人，白世祖，求改名為粲，不許。
units.en: Min Sun from youth admired Xun Fengqian's conduct; he told the Shizu and asked to change his name to Can; permission was refused.
units.literal: Min Sun from youth admired Xun Fengqian's conduct; he told the Shizu and asked to change his name to Can; it was not permitted.

units.zh: 至是言於太宗，乃改為粲，字景倩焉。
units.en: At this time he spoke to Emperor Ming, and was then changed to Can, with style name Jingqian.
units.literal: At this time he spoke to Emperor Ming, and then was changed to Can, with style name Jingqian.

units.zh: 二年，遷領軍將軍，仗士三十人入六門。
units.en: In the second year, he was transferred to Commander-in-Chief, with thirty armed soldiers entering the Six Gates.
units.literal: In the second year, he was transferred to Commander-in-Chief, with thirty armed soldiers entering the Six Gates.

units.zh: 其年，徙中書令，領太子詹事，增封三百戶，固辭不受。
units.en: That year he was moved to Secretariat Director, concurrently Household Mentor of the Heir; his fief was increased by three hundred households, but he firmly declined.
units.literal: That year he was moved to Secretariat Director, concurrently Household Mentor of the Heir; his fief was increased by three hundred households, but he firmly declined and did not accept.

units.zh: 三年，轉尚書僕射，尋領吏部。
units.en: In the third year, he was transferred to Secretariat Vice Director and soon headed the Ministry of Personnel.
units.literal: In the third year, he was transferred to Secretariat Vice Director and soon headed the Ministry of Personnel.

units.zh: 五年，加中書令，又領丹陽尹。
units.en: In the fifth year, he was additionally made Secretariat Director and also Governor of Danyang.
units.literal: In the fifth year, he was additionally made Secretariat Director and also Governor of Danyang.

units.zh: 六年，上於華林園茅堂講《周易》，粲為執經。
units.en: In the sixth year, the emperor at the thatched hall of Hualin Garden lectured on the Book of Changes; Can held the classic.
units.literal: In the sixth year, the Emperor at the thatched hall of Hualin Garden lectured on the Book of Changes; Can held the classic.

units.zh: 又知東宮事，徙為右僕射。
units.en: He also oversaw Eastern Palace affairs and was moved to Right Vice Director.
units.literal: He also knew Eastern Palace affairs and was moved to Right Vice Director.

units.zh: 七年，領太子詹事，僕射如故。
units.en: In the seventh year, he headed the Household of the Heir as Mentor, with his vice directorship unchanged.
units.literal: In the seventh year, he headed the Household of the Heir as Mentor, with his vice directorship unchanged.

units.zh: 未拜，遷尚書令，丹陽尹如故。
units.en: Before he received appointment, he was moved to Secretariat Director, with his Danyang governorship unchanged.
units.literal: Before he received appointment, he was moved to Secretariat Director, with his Danyang governorship unchanged.

units.zh: 坐前選武衛將軍江柳為江州刺史，柳有罪，降為守尚書令。
units.en: He was punished because in a prior selection he had appointed Jiang Liu as General of the Martial Guard and Governor of Jiang Province; Liu was guilty, and Can was reduced to acting Secretariat Director.
units.literal: He was punished because in a prior selection he had appointed Jiang Liu as General of the Martial Guard and Governor of Jiang Province; Liu had guilt, and Can was reduced to acting Secretariat Director.

units.zh: 太宗臨崩，粲與褚淵、劉勔並受顧命，加班劍二十人，給鼓吹一部。
units.en: When Emperor Ming was on his deathbed, Can together with Chu Yuan and Liu Mian all received the dying imperial command; he was given twenty ceremonial halberds and one set of trumpets and drums.
units.literal: When Emperor Ming was on his deathbed, Can together with Chu Yuan and Liu Mian all received the dying imperial command; he was given twenty ceremonial halberds and one set of trumpets and drums.

units.zh: 後廢帝即位，加兵五百人。
units.en: When the Later Deposed Emperor took the throne, his guard was increased by five hundred men.
units.literal: When the Later Deposed Emperor took the throne, his guard was increased by five hundred men.

units.zh: 帝未親朝政，下詔曰：「比亢序愆度，留熏燿晷，有傷秋稼，方貽民瘼。
units.en: The emperor had not yet personally handled court affairs and issued an edict saying: "Recently the order of the celestial mansions has been out of measure, lingering heat has prolonged the days, harming the autumn crops and about to bring suffering to the people.
units.literal: The emperor had not yet personally handled court affairs and issued an edict saying: "Recently the order of the celestial mansions has been out of measure, lingering heat has prolonged the days, harming the autumn crops and about to bring suffering to the people.

units.zh: 朕以眇疚，未弘政道，囹圄尚繁，枉滯猶積，晨兢夕厲，每惻于懷。
units.en: I, being young and afflicted, have not yet broadened the way of government; prisons remain numerous and wrongful detentions still accumulate; morning and evening I am vigilant and anxious, each time grieved at heart.
units.literal: I, being young and afflicted, have not yet broadened the way of government; prisons remain numerous and wrongful detentions still accumulate; morning and evening I am vigilant and anxious, each time grieved at heart.

units.zh: 尚書令可與執法以下，就訊眾獄，使冤訟洗遂，困弊昭蘇。
units.en: The Secretariat Director, together with law-enforcement officials and below, should go and examine the various prisons, so that wrongful suits may be cleared and the distressed and exhausted may be revived.
units.literal: The Secretariat Director, together with law-enforcement officials and below, should go and examine the various prisons, so that wrongful suits may be cleared and the distressed and exhausted may be revived.

units.zh: 頒下州郡，咸令無壅。」
units.en: Issue this throughout the provinces and commanderies, all being ordered to permit no obstruction."
units.literal: Issue this throughout the provinces and commanderies, all being ordered to permit no obstruction."

units.zh: 元徽元年，丁母憂，葬竟，攝令親職，加衞將軍，不受，敦逼備至，中使相望，粲終不受。
units.en: In the first year of Yuanhui, he entered mourning for his mother; when the burial was completed, he was ordered to resume personal duty and was additionally made Guards General; he did not accept; urgings were pressed to the utmost and palace envoys followed one after another, but Can in the end did not accept.
units.literal: In the first year of Yuanhui, he entered mourning for his mother; when the burial was completed, he was ordered to resume personal duty and was additionally made Guards General; he did not accept; urgings were pressed to the utmost and palace envoys followed one after another, but Can in the end did not accept.

units.zh: 性至孝，居喪毀甚，祖日及祥變，常發詔衞軍斷客。
units.en: By nature he was extremely filial; during mourning he was greatly wasted; on the anniversary of his grandfather's death and at the mourning anniversaries, edicts were often issued for the Guards General to bar visitors.
units.literal: By nature he was extremely filial; during mourning he was greatly wasted; on the anniversary of his grandfather's death and at the mourning anniversaries, edicts were often issued for the Guards General to bar visitors.

units.zh: 二年，桂陽王休範為逆，粲扶曳入殿，詔加兵自隨，府置佐史。
units.en: In the second year, the Prince of Guiyang Xiufan rebelled; Can, supporting himself, dragged into the hall; an edict added armed guards at his side and his headquarters was given aides and clerks.
units.literal: In the second year, the Prince of Guiyang Xiufan rebelled; Can, supporting himself, dragged into the hall; an edict added armed guards at his side and his headquarters was given aides and clerks.

units.zh: 時兵難危急，賊已至南掖門，諸將意沮，咸莫能奮。
units.en: At the time military hardship was urgent; the bandits had already reached the Southern Side Gate; the generals' spirits were dejected and none could rouse themselves.
units.literal: At the time military hardship was urgent and critical; the bandits had already reached the Southern Side Gate; the generals' will was dejected and none could rouse themselves.

units.zh: 粲慷慨謂諸將帥曰：「寇賊已逼，而眾情離沮。
units.en: Can passionately told the generals: "Bandits and thieves have already pressed close, yet the troops' spirits are divided and dejected.
units.literal: Can passionately told the generals: "Bandits and thieves have already pressed close, yet the multitude's feeling is divided and dejected.

units.zh: 孤子受先帝顧託，本以死報，今日當與褚護軍同死社稷！」
units.en: I, an orphaned son, received the late emperor's entrustment and originally meant to repay with my life; today I should die with Protector General Chu for the altars of state!
units.literal: I, a lone man, received the late Emperor's entrustment and originally meant to repay with death; today I should die with Protector General Chu for the altars of state!"

units.zh: 因命左右被馬，辭色哀壯。
units.en: Thereupon he ordered attendants to saddle horses; his words and bearing were mournful and strong.
units.literal: Thereupon he ordered attendants to saddle horses; his words and color were mournful and strong.

units.zh: 於是陳顯達等感激出戰，賊即平殄。
units.en: Thereupon Chen Xianda and others, stirred to action, went out to battle, and the bandits were at once destroyed.
units.literal: Thereupon Chen Xianda and others, stirred, went out to battle, and the bandits were at once exterminated.

units.zh: 事寧，授中書監，即本號開府儀同三司，領司徒，以揚州解為府，固不肯移。
units.en: When affairs were settled, he was made Supervisor of the Secretariat, with his original title as Commissioner with ceremonial staff equal to the Three Dukes, heading the Minister of Education (Situ) post; the Yang Province headquarters building was assigned as his office—he firmly refused to move.
units.literal: When affairs were settled, he was made Supervisor of the Secretariat, with his original title as Commissioner with the Golden Grandee's insignia and ceremonial staff equal to the Three Dukes, heading the Ministry of Rites; Yang Province was dissolved as his headquarters—he firmly refused to move.

units.zh: 三年，徙尚書令，衛軍、開府如故，並固辭，服終乃受。
units.en: In the third year, he was moved to Secretariat Director, with his Guards General and Commissioner posts unchanged; again he firmly declined, and only after mourning ended did he accept.
units.literal: In the third year, he was moved to Secretariat Director, with his Guards General and Commissioner posts unchanged; again he firmly declined, and only after mourning ended did he accept.

units.zh: 加侍中，進爵為侯，又不受。
units.en: He was additionally made Palace Attendant and advanced in rank to marquis; again he did not accept.
units.literal: He was additionally made Palace Attendant and advanced in rank to marquis; again he did not accept.

units.zh: 時粲與齊王、褚淵、劉秉入直，平決萬機，時謂之「四貴」。
units.en: At the time Can, with the Prince of Qi, Chu Yuan, and Liu Bing, entered duty and jointly decided state affairs; the age called them "the Four Esteemed."
units.literal: At the time Can, with the Prince of Qi, Chu Yuan, and Liu Bing, entered duty and jointly decided the ten thousand affairs; the age called them "the Four Esteemed."

units.zh: 粲閑默寡言，不肯當事，主書每往諮決，或高詠對之，時立一意，則眾莫能改。
units.en: Can was quiet and taciturn, unwilling to take charge of affairs; when chief clerks came to consult and decide, he sometimes answered with lofty chanting; when he once set his mind, none could change it.
units.literal: Can was quiet and taciturn, unwilling to take charge of affairs; when chief clerks came to consult and decide, he sometimes answered with lofty chanting; when he once set an intention, none could change it.

units.zh: 宅宇平素，器物取給。
units.en: His dwelling was plain and simple; utensils were taken as needed.
units.literal: His dwelling was plain and simple; utensils were taken as needed.

units.zh: 好飲酒，善吟諷，獨酌園庭，以此自適。
units.en: He loved wine and was skilled at chanting; alone he poured wine in the garden courtyard and thereby found his ease.
units.literal: He loved drinking wine and was skilled at chanting; alone he poured wine in the garden courtyard and thereby found his ease.

units.zh: 居負南郭，時杖策獨遊，素寡往來，門無雜客。
units.en: He lived facing the southern outer wall; he often walked with a staff and roamed alone; he had always few visitors, and his gate had no miscellaneous guests.
units.literal: He lived facing the southern outer wall; he often walked with a staff and roamed alone; he had always few comings and goings, and his gate had no miscellaneous guests.

units.zh: 及受遺當權，四方輻湊，閒居高臥，一無所接，談客文士，所見不過一兩人。
units.en: When he received the entrustment and held power, the four directions converged like wheel spokes; he reclined in leisure and received none of them; talking guests and literary men—those he saw did not exceed one or two.
units.literal: When he received the entrustment and held power, the four directions converged like wheel spokes; he reclined on high in leisure and received nothing; talking guests and literary men—those he saw did not exceed one or two.

units.zh: 順帝即位，遷中書監，司徒、侍中如故。
units.en: When Emperor Shun took the throne, he was moved to Supervisor of the Secretariat, with his posts as Minister of Education (Situ) and Palace Attendant unchanged.
units.literal: When Emperor Shun took the throne, he was moved to Supervisor of the Secretariat, with his posts as Minister of Rites and Palace Attendant unchanged.

units.zh: 時齊王居東府，故使粲鎮石頭。
units.en: At the time the Prince of Qi resided at the Eastern Headquarters, so Can was sent to garrison Stone Fortress.
units.literal: At the time the Prince of Qi resided at the Eastern Headquarters, so Can was sent to garrison Stone Fortress.

units.zh: 粲素靜退，每有朝命，多不即從，逼切不得已，然後方就。
units.en: Can was by nature quiet and retiring; whenever there was a court command he often did not immediately comply; only when pressed urgently and with no alternative would he finally go.
units.literal: Can was by nature quiet and retiring; whenever there was a court command he often did not immediately comply; only when pressed urgently and with no alternative would he finally go.

units.zh: 及詔移石頭，即便順旨。
units.en: When the edict ordered his move to Stone Fortress, he at once complied with the imperial will.
units.literal: When the edict ordered his move to Stone Fortress, he at once complied with the imperial will.

units.zh: 有周旋人解望氣，謂粲曰：「石頭氣甚乖，往必有禍。」
units.en: A companion skilled in reading qi omens said to Can: "The qi at Stone Fortress is very adverse; if you go there will surely be calamity."
units.literal: A companion skilled in reading qi omens said to Can: "The qi at Stone Fortress is very adverse; if you go there will surely be calamity."

units.zh: 粲不答。
units.en: Can did not answer.
units.literal: Can did not answer.

units.zh: 又給油絡通幰車，仗士五十人入殿。
units.en: He was also given an oiled carriage with connecting canopy and fifty armed soldiers entering the hall.
units.literal: He was also given an oiled carriage with connecting canopy and fifty armed soldiers entering the hall.

units.zh: 時齊王功高德重，天命有歸，粲自以身受顧託，不欲事二姓，密有異圖。
units.en: At the time the Prince of Qi's merit was high and his virtue weighty, and Heaven's mandate was tending toward him; Can, considering that he himself had received the dying imperial entrustment, did not wish to serve two dynasties and secretly harbored a separate plan.
units.literal: At the time the Prince of Qi's merit was high and his virtue weighty, and Heaven's mandate was tending toward him; Can, considering that he himself had received the dying imperial entrustment, did not wish to serve two dynasties and secretly harbored a separate plan.

units.zh: 丹陽尹劉秉，宋代宗室，前湘州刺史王蘊，太后兄子，素好武事，並慮不見容於齊王，皆與粲相結。
units.en: Liu Bing, Governor of Danyang, a member of the Song imperial clan, and Wang Yun, former Inspector of Xiang Province, the Empress Dowager's elder brother's son, who had always loved military affairs—all feared they would not be tolerated by the Prince of Qi—and all joined with Can in conspiracy.
units.literal: Liu Bing, Governor of Danyang, a member of the Song imperial clan, and Wang Yun, former Inspector of Xiang Province, the Empress Dowager's elder brother's son, who had always loved military affairs—all feared they would not be tolerated by the Prince of Qi—and all joined with Can in conspiracy.

units.zh: 將帥黃回、任候伯、孫曇瓘、王宜興、彭文之、卜伯興等，並與粲合。
units.en: The generals Huang Hui, Ren Houbo, Sun Tanjuan, Wang Yixing, Peng Wenzhi, Bu Boxing, and others all allied with Can.
units.literal: The generals Huang Hui, Ren Houbo, Sun Tanjuan, Wang Yixing, Peng Wenzhi, Bu Boxing, and others all allied with Can.

units.zh: 昇明元年，荊州刺史沈攸之舉兵，齊王自詣粲，粲稱疾不見。
units.en: In the first year of Shengming, Jing Province Inspector Shen Youzhi raised troops; the Prince of Qi personally went to Can; Can claimed illness and did not see him.
units.literal: In the first year of Shengming, Jing Province Inspector Shen Youzhi raised troops; the Prince of Qi personally went to Can; Can claimed illness and did not see him.

units.zh: 粲宗人通直郎袁達以為不宜示異同，粲曰：「彼若以主幼時艱，與桂陽時不異，劫我入臺，便無辭以拒。
units.en: Can's clansman the Imperial Courier Yuan Da thought one should not display difference of view; Can said: "If he, because the sovereign is young and the times hard, treats this as no different from the Guiyang affair, and forces me into the terrace, I will have no words to refuse.
units.literal: Can's clansman the Imperial Courier Yuan Da thought one should not display difference of view; Can said: "If he, because the sovereign is young and the times hard, does not differ from the Guiyang time, and forces me into the terrace, I will have no words to refuse.

units.zh: 一如此，不復得出矣。」
units.en: Once it is like this, I will not be able to come out again."
units.literal: Once it is like this, I will not be able to come out again."

units.zh: 時齊王入屯朝堂，秉從父弟領軍將軍韞入直門下省，伯興為直閣，黃回諸將皆率軍出新亭。
units.en: At the time the Prince of Qi entered and garrisoned the court hall; Bing's younger paternal cousin Yun, the Commander-in-Chief, went on duty in the Chancellery; Boxing served as Direct Attendant of the Pavilion; and Huang Hui and the other generals all led troops out to Xinting.
units.literal: At the time the Prince of Qi entered and garrisoned the court hall; Bing's younger paternal cousin Commander-in-Chief Yun entered duty in the Chancellery; Boxing was Direct Attendant; Huang Hui and the various generals all led armies out to Xinting.

units.zh: 粲謀克日矯太后令，使韞、伯興率宿衛兵攻齊王於朝堂，回率軍來應。
units.en: Can plotted on a set day to forge the Empress Dowager's order, making Yun and Boxing lead palace guards to attack the Prince of Qi in the court hall; Hui would lead the army to respond.
units.literal: Can plotted on a set day to forge the Empress Dowager's order, making Yun and Boxing lead palace guards to attack the Prince of Qi in the court hall; Hui would lead the army to respond.

units.zh: 秉、候伯等並赴石頭，本期夜發。
units.en: Bing, Hou Bo, and others all went to Stone Fortress; the original plan was to set out at night.
units.literal: Bing, Hou Bo, and others all went to Stone Fortress; the original plan was to set out at night.

units.zh: 其日秉恇擾不知所為，晡後便束裝，未闇，載婦女席捲就粲，由此事泄。
units.en: That day Bing was fearful and disturbed and did not know what to do; after mid-afternoon he at once packed; before dark he loaded women and bedding and went to Can; thereby the affair was leaked.
units.literal: That day Bing was fearful and disturbed and did not know what to do; after mid-afternoon he at once packed; before dark he loaded women and bedding and went to Can; thereby the affair was leaked.

units.zh: 先是，齊王遣將薛淵、蘇烈、王天生等領兵戍石頭，云以助粲，實禦之也。
units.en: Earlier, the Prince of Qi had sent generals Xue Yuan, Su Lie, Wang Tiansheng, and others to lead troops to garrison Stone Fortress, saying to assist Can but in truth to guard against him.
units.literal: Earlier, the Prince of Qi had sent generals Xue Yuan, Su Lie, Wang Tiansheng, and others to lead troops to garrison Stone Fortress, saying to assist Can but in truth to guard against him.

units.zh: 又令腹心王敬則為直閣，與伯興共揔禁兵。
units.en: He also made his trusted follower Wang Jingze Direct Attendant, together with Boxing jointly commanding forbidden troops.
units.literal: He also made his trusted follower Wang Jingze Direct Attendant, together with Boxing jointly commanding forbidden troops.

units.zh: 王蘊聞秉已奔，歎曰：「今年事敗矣！」
units.en: Wang Yun heard Bing had already fled and sighed: "This year's affair is lost!"
units.literal: Wang Yun heard Bing had already fled and sighed: "This year's affair is lost!"

units.zh: 時齊王使蘊募人，已得數百，乃狼狽率部曲向石頭。
units.en: At the time the Prince of Qi sent Yun to recruit men; he had already gotten several hundred; then in distress he led his subordinates toward Stone Fortress.
units.literal: At the time the Prince of Qi sent Yun to recruit men; he had already gotten several hundred; then in distress he led his subordinates toward Stone Fortress.

units.zh: 本期開南門，時已闇夜，薛淵等據門射之，蘊謂粲已敗，即便散走。
units.en: The original plan was to open the southern gate; it was already dark night; Xue Yuan and others held the gate and shot at them; Yun thought Can had already been defeated and at once scattered and fled.
units.literal: The original plan was to open the southern gate; it was already dark night; Xue Yuan and others held the gate and shot at them; Yun thought Can had already been defeated and at once scattered and fled.

units.zh: 齊王以報敬則，率所領收蘊殺之，并誅伯興。
units.en: The Prince of Qi reported to Jingze; he led those under him to seize and kill Yun, and Boxing was also executed.
units.literal: The Prince of Qi reported to Jingze; he led those under him to seize and kill Yun, and Boxing was also executed.

units.zh: 又遣軍主戴僧靜向石頭助薛淵，自倉門得入。
units.en: He also sent Army Commander Dai Sengjing toward Stone Fortress to assist Xue Yuan; he entered from the Granary Gate.
units.literal: He also sent Army Commander Dai Sengjing toward Stone Fortress to assist Xue Yuan; he entered from the Granary Gate.

units.zh: 時粲與秉等列兵登東門，僧靜分兵攻府西門。
units.en: At the time Can and Bing and others arrayed troops and ascended the eastern gate; Sengjing divided troops to attack the headquarters' western gate.
units.literal: At the time Can and Bing and others arrayed troops and ascended the eastern gate; Sengjing divided troops to attack the headquarters' western gate.

units.zh: 粲與秉欲還赴府，既下城，列燭自照，僧靜挺身闇往，粲子最覺有異人，以身衛粲，僧靜直前斬之，父子俱殞，左右各分散。
units.en: Can and Bing wished to return to the headquarters; having descended the wall, they set out candles to illuminate themselves; Sengjing advanced straight through the dark; Can's son Zui felt there was an unusual man and used his body to protect Can; Sengjing went straight forward and cut him down; father and son both perished; attendants each scattered.
units.literal: Can and Bing wished to return to the headquarters; having descended the wall, they set out candles to illuminate themselves; Sengjing straightened his body in the dark and went forward; Can's son Zui felt there was an unusual man and used his body to protect Can; Sengjing went straight forward and cut him down; father and son both perished; attendants each scattered.

units.zh: 粲死時，年五十八。
units.en: When Can died, he was fifty-eight.
units.literal: When Can died, he was fifty-eight.

units.zh: 任候伯等其夜並乘輕舸，自新亭赴石頭，聞粲敗，乃馳還；
units.en: Ren Houbo and others that night all rode light boats from Xinting toward Stone Fortress; hearing Can was defeated, they galloped back;
units.literal: Ren Houbo and others that night all rode light boats from Xinting toward Stone Fortress; hearing Can was defeated, they galloped back;

units.zh: 其後並誅。
units.en: afterward they were all executed.
units.literal: afterward they were all executed.

units.zh: 秉事在《宗室傳》。
units.en: Bing's affair is in the "Imperial Clan Biography."
units.literal: Bing's affair is in the "Imperial Clan Biography."

units.zh: 齊永明元年，詔曰：「昔魏矜袁紹，恩給丘墳；
units.en: In the first year of Yongming under Qi, an edict said: "Formerly Wei showed pity for Yuan Shao and bestowed favor on his mound and tomb;
units.literal: In the first year of Yongming under Qi, an edict said: "Formerly Wei showed pity for Yuan Shao and bestowed favor on his mound and tomb;

units.zh: 晉亮兩王，榮覃餘裔。
units.en: Jin honored the Two Kings, extending glory to their remaining descendants.
units.literal: Jin honored the Two Kings, extending glory to their remaining descendants.

units.zh: 斯蓋懷舊流仁，原心興宥，二代弘義，前載美談。
units.en: This was surely carrying forward benevolence through cherishing the old, extending clemency by examining the heart—magnanimous righteousness in two dynasties, a beautiful theme in former records.
units.literal: This was surely carrying forward benevolence through cherishing the old, extending clemency by examining the heart—magnanimous righteousness in two dynasties, a beautiful theme in former records.

units.zh: 袁粲、劉秉，並與先朝同奬宋室，沈攸之於景和之世，特有乃心，雖末節不終，而始誠可錄。
units.en: Yuan Can and Liu Bing both together with the former court supported the Song house; Shen Youzhi in the Jinghe era had a special loyal heart; although their final conduct did not run its course, their original sincerity is worth recording.
units.literal: Yuan Can and Liu Bing both together with the former court supported the Song house; Shen Youzhi in the Jinghe era had a special loyal heart; although their final conduct did not run its course, their original sincerity is worth recording.

units.zh: 歲月彌往，宜沾優隆，粲、秉前年改葬，塋兆未修，材官可為經略，粗合周禮。
units.en: As years pass ever further, they should receive honored elevation; Can and Bing were reburied in the year before last, but their grave precincts are not yet repaired—the Works Office may plan the work, roughly in accord with the Zhou Rites.
units.literal: As years pass ever further, they should receive honored elevation; Can and Bing were reburied in the year before last, but their grave precincts are not yet repaired—the Works Office may plan the work, roughly in accord with the Zhou Rites.

units.zh: 攸之及其諸子喪柩在西，可符荊州以時致送，還反舊墓，在所營葬事。」
units.en: Youzhi and his sons' coffins are in the west; Jing Province should be instructed to deliver them in due time, return them to the old graves, and undertake the burial affairs locally."
units.literal: Youzhi and his sons' coffins are in the west; Jing Province should be instructed to deliver them in due time, return them to the old graves, and undertake the burial affairs locally."

units.zh: 史臣曰：闢運創基，非機變無以通其務，世及繼體，非忠貞無以守其業。
units.en: The historian states: To open fortune and found the foundation, without adaptability one cannot penetrate its tasks; hereditary succession and continuing the body, without loyal steadfastness one cannot guard its enterprise.
units.literal: The historian states: To open fortune and found the foundation, without adaptability one cannot penetrate its tasks; hereditary succession and continuing the body, without loyal steadfastness one cannot guard its enterprise.

units.zh: 辟運之君，千載一有，世及之主，無乏於時，囗囗須機變之用短，資忠貞之路長也。
units.en: Lords who open fortune are one in a thousand years; lords of hereditary succession are not lacking in their time; □□ the short use of adaptability, the long road of loyal steadfastness.
units.literal: Lords who open fortune are one in a thousand years; lords of hereditary succession are not lacking in their time; □□ the short use of adaptability, the long road of loyal steadfastness.

units.zh: 故漢室□□，文舉不屈曹氏，魏鼎將移，夏侯義不北面。
units.en: Therefore the Han house □□, Wenju would not submit to the Cao clan; when Wei's tripod was about to shift, Xiahou in righteousness would not face north.
units.literal: Therefore the Han house □□, Wenju would not submit to the Cao clan; when Wei's tripod was about to shift, Xiahou in righteousness would not face north.

units.zh: 若悉以二子為心，則兩代宜不亡矣。
units.en: If all took the two masters as their heart, then both dynasties should not have perished.
units.literal: If all took the two masters as their heart, then both dynasties should not have perished.

units.zh: 袁粲清標簡貴，任屬負圖，朝野之望雖隆，然未以大節許也。
units.en: Yuan Can's pure mark was simple and noble; his commission bore the burden of the state; though court and countryside hope was lofty, yet he was not yet approved in great integrity.
units.literal: Yuan Can's pure mark was simple and noble; his commission bore the burden of the chart; though court and countryside hope was lofty, yet he was not yet approved in great integrity.

units.zh: 及其赴危亡，審存滅，豈所謂義重於生乎！
units.en: When he went to meet danger and death, he chose preservation of principle over survival—was this not righteousness heavier than life!
units.literal: When he went to meet danger and death, he examined preservation and extinction—was this not called righteousness heavier than life!

units.zh: 雖不達天命，而其道有足懷者。
units.en: Though he did not penetrate Heaven's mandate, yet his Way has what is worth cherishing.
units.literal: Though he did not penetrate Heaven's mandate, yet his Way has what is worth cherishing.

units.zh: 昔王經被旌於晉世，粲等亦改葬於聖朝，盛代同符，美矣！
units.en: Formerly Wang Jing was honored in the Jin age; Can and others were also reburied in the sagely dynasty—flourishing ages share the seal, beautiful indeed!
units.literal: Formerly Wang Jing was honored in the Jin age; Can and others were also reburied in the sagely dynasty—flourishing ages share the seal, beautiful indeed!

Same mother does not imply same birth year. Later allusions are not personal activity. Research or record a blocker rather than invent precision.
